concept.title: Membership benefits
concept.shortdesc: As a member, you get access to a verified catalog of secure, patched open source artifacts through the Red Hat Lightwell Network.

conbody.p: The membership includes the following supply chain deliverables:

ul.li: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) documentation, such as CycloneDX
SLSA L3 build provenance that is built by using a secure supply chain and signed with Sigstore or cosign
